_comment: Tooling-detection evals for Step 3 of the auth0 router. Each case lists the backticked project signals present (verbatim from SKILL.md's Step 3 table) and asserts the tooling the 'stop at first match' cascade resolves to. This locks down the row ordering (the specific `*.tf`/`terraform/` row must beat the catch-all default) and the default fall-through to the CLI. Run with scripts/check_tooling_detection.py. OUT OF SCOPE (see the checker's module docstring): the `tooling-mcp.md` row keys off 'Auth0 MCP server active in this agent session' — a session RUNTIME signal, not a file on disk, so it carries no backticked token to model mechanically.

cases._why: A `terraform/` directory is the specific signal; the Terraform row must win over the catch-all default below it.
The row is an OR-group (`terraform/` directory OR any `*.tf` files); a bare `*.tf` signal must also resolve to terraform.
No Terraform signal and no MCP session -> the 'Anything else (default)' row resolves to the CLI.
An unrelated project signal must still fall through to the CLI default, not accidentally match the Terraform row.
